[Clinical manifestations in patients with computerized tomography diagnosis of neurocysticercosis].
A survey was conducted in the urban area of Lages using patients who had been submitted to a computed tomography of the skull in the period of March-December, 1996, for different reasons. Forty-two patients with a provisional diagnosis of neurocysticercosis, and 57 negatives were personally interviewed by one of the authors (Pfuetzenreiter), using a semi-structured procedure. More individuals with a provisional diagnostic of neurocysticercosis reported clinical manifestations related to this infection than those found negative. This difference is more marked among women, except in relation to convulsions, more frequently reported by men (19.05%) than by women (7.14%). The greater percentage of inactive forms (83.33%) and a longer history of perceived symptoms among those positives suggest that the condition is not new.

• 电子游戏让我们在虚拟世界里攻城略地、杀人越货，一个晚上就能登基宇宙之王，可以满足我们的成就感，却没有多少现实意义；
• 互联网上那无穷无尽的链接，可以满足我们的好奇心，但铺天盖地而来的信息却反倒可能损害我们的判断力；
• 成人图片、成人电影，可以满足男性对色情场面的需求，却不可能带来真正的子孙；
• 电视剧可以满足人类打探别人生活的本能，但却不能带来什么有用的信息；
• 化妆品，可以满足女性爱美的天性，但美貌本是健康的衡量，把钱和时间花在化妆上，而不是去锻炼身体，是本末倒置；
• 减肥，可以减少女性的腰臀比，而腰臀比是生殖能力的指标，可过度减肥，反倒会降低生殖能力；
• 某些意识形态和宗教组织，利用人追寻人生意义的天性，许诺简单易行的天堂路径，最终害人害己；
• 成功学，利用人追求成功的天性，但当人太执着于成功时，幸福感会降低。

1.  容易获得；

Pilaf (also known as pilau and plov), is a dish in which rice is cooked in a seasoned broth. Here's a delicious pilaf made with barley instead of rice.
Heat oil in a large saucepan and gently cook onion and garlic until tender.
Add mushrooms, barley and thyme and stir to coat with oil.
Add stock and bring to the boil. Turn down the heat, and simmer, covered, for 1 hour or until barley is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Stir through spinach leaves and serve sprinkled with the slivered almonds.
Tip : Pilaf can be made with rice instead of barley, reducing cooking time to 20 minutes. How can I modify the recipe to make the pilaf using rice instead of barley?<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
Here is the modified recipe to make the pilaf using rice instead of barley:

Ingredients:
- 2 tablespoons oil
- 1 onion, finely chopped
- 2 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 cup sliced mushrooms
- 2 cups long-grain rice
- 1 teaspoon thyme
- 4 cups vegetable or chicken stock
- 1 cup spinach leaves
- 1/4 cup slivered almonds

Directions:
1. In a large saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
2. Add the mushrooms, rice, and thyme and stir to coat with oil. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the rice is slightly toasted.
3. Add the stock and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer. Cover and cook for 20 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
4. Stir in the spinach leaves and cook for 2-3 minutes until wilted.
5. Serve hot, sprinkled with slivered almonds. Enjoy!<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
That modified recipe sounds great, but can I use chicken stock instead of vegetable stock?<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
Yes, you can use chicken stock instead of vegetable stock if you prefer. Chicken stock will give the rice a richer flavor, but vegetarian can use vegetable stock to keep the dish vegetarian. Simply substitute the chicken stock with the same amount of vegetable stock in the recipe. Enjoy your rice pilaf!<|im_end|>
